notes.quote: when Sol stopped pretending to sleep
notes.body: 🤖 Changed from "when Sol shut her eyes at one": line 3 says Sol "had not slept", so shutting her eyes read like sleep. Also drops the counter/counter/counter repeat. Undo from the Claude feed or History if you prefer the old line.

notes.quote: "You can sit," Sol said. She had put a slice of bread on the counter an hour ago, by the notebook, and it was still there. "You can also eat."
